summary: The phone flow (steps 1-12, the tip and the troubleshooting line) holds against b46b47d3 at 380px. #hm-new is the round + at the bottom of Home and opens the New project dialog, which has a "9:16 Phone" tile and a Create button and does not autofocus on touch. The empty timeline shows the 64px round + with "Tap here to start creating" under it, and it opens the Add sheet with labelled tabs. Media → Import media closes the sheet (onAfterAdd = closeAdd) and opens the picker. The imported clip is selected, and its options dock below its row. The time counter reads 00:00:00 (MM:SS:FF) and plays/pauses on tap. One back-arrow tap deselects, and a second goes Home. The up-arrow #m-export is then the rightmost button in the top bar. The export button reads "Export MP4" for the default MP4 format. "Export ready" → Save opens the share sheet, a dismissed sheet re-enables Save, and with no share support the file downloads. The text is 295 words without comments, which is clear and inside the 150-350 range. Only the "On a computer" paragraph is wrong, and it is wrong in three places. (1) It says to click a + on the empty timeline; on a computer that is a hidden 7px line, and the Add panel is already open. (2) Export is third from the right end, behind Timeline options and View options. (3) It does not say to skip step 9; on a computer the back arrow goes straight to Home. Suggested replacement for the whole paragraph (about 320 words in total): "On a computer: the Add panel is already open while nothing is selected, so there is no big + to click. Click its **Media** tab, then **Import media**, or drag a video or photo onto the picture. Skip step 9: on a computer the back arrow goes straight to Home, and Export is always showing. Export is the up-arrow near the right end of the row under the picture, the third button from the end." summary: Verdict: fix. Steps 1-3 and 6-7 hold up on a 380px phone: tap selects, the centre playhead is fixed, the row of icons sits at the top of the docked sheet, the icon description and left/middle/right order are right, handles arm in 300ms and turn teal, and the clip moves after a still hold. The main fault is step order. Every cut (split, trim start, trim end) leaves the playhead on the clip's edge, so the three buttons swap to Move/Extend. A user going from step 4 to step 5 taps Move instead and gets a misleading 'No more source to extend into' toast. The warning sits in a paragraph after step 7, and it wrongly says 'slide into a piece': only the right-hand piece is selected, and on a phone it is the only one shown. The computer paragraph states A and D with no condition, though off the clip they move the clip. It also leaves out the visible A/S/D buttons at the top right of the panel, and that a mouse needs no hold and never sees teal. Smaller fixes: 'either end' for the handles, '(if there is one)' for ⇄, and a concrete wait cue in the troubleshooting line. Length is about 287 words now and about 340 with the fixes, fine for a beginner. Exact replacement text is in each item. The tutorial is at cf8c210c:tutorials/02-trim-and-split.md; the round-1 notes are in /Users/ezrasmith/Claude/FreeMotion/tools/design/tutorials/REVIEW.md.
